say:1:1030110701:0.text: Thankfully, no one lost their life in the fire. It could've been a lot worse.
say:1:1030110701:0.source_cn: 没有人因为火灾失去生命，这是不幸中的大幸。
say:1:1030110701:0.male: Thankfully, no one lost their life in the fire. It could've been a lot worse.
say:1:1030110701:0.female: Thankfully, no one lost their life in the fire. It could've been a lot worse.

say:2:1030110702:0.text: But many have minor injuries, and several children are awfully frightened.
say:2:1030110702:0.source_cn: 但是……有不少人受了轻伤，一些小孩子也受到了惊吓。
say:2:1030110702:0.male: But many have minor injuries, and several children are awfully frightened.
say:2:1030110702:0.female: But many have minor injuries, and several children are awfully frightened.

say:3:1030110703:0.text: It was a poor harvest this year in Northville, and for folks here, it's all they've got.
say:3:1030110703:0.source_cn: 北村的麦地今年歉收，这些麦子对不少人来说，都是非常宝贵...
say:3:1030110703:0.male: It was a poor harvest this year in Northville, and for folks here, it's all they've got.
say:3:1030110703:0.female: It was a poor harvest this year in Northville, and for folks here, it's all they've got.

say:4:1030110704:0.text: Everyone survived the fire, but a lot of them inhaled a lot of smoke while trying to save the wheat.
say:4:1030110704:0.source_cn: 所以，有很多人虽然没有受伤，但是却为了抢救麦子，吸入了...
say:4:1030110704:0.male: Everyone survived the fire, but a lot of them inhaled a lot of smoke while trying to save the wheat.
say:4:1030110704:0.female: Everyone survived the fire, but a lot of them inhaled a lot of smoke while trying to save the wheat.

say:5:1030110705:0.text: Whoever did this... when the general catches them, I'll make sure they'll suffer!
say:5:1030110705:0.source_cn: 可恶，等将军捉到那个纵火犯，我非踹他两脚不可！
say:5:1030110705:0.male: Whoever did this... when the general catches them, I'll make sure they'll suffer!
say:5:1030110705:0.female: Whoever did this... when the general catches them, I'll make sure they'll suffer!

say:6:1030110706:0.text: Sorry... I didn't mean to say that out loud...
say:6:1030110706:0.male: Sorry... I didn't mean to say that out loud...
say:6:1030110706:0.female: Sorry... I didn't mean to say that out loud...

say:10:1030110708:0.source_cn: 如果我到时候不在场，就麻烦您替我揍他了。
say:10:1030110708:0.male: If I'm not around, make sure they get what's coming to them.
say:10:1030110708:0.female: If I'm not around, make sure they get what's coming to them.
